purpose: Connect alternatives in a formal choice.
keywords: N / clause + もしくは + N / clause
A seal or a signature is required.
Please submit it by mail or at the counter.
We will decide whether to postpone or cancel.
formation: N / clause + もしくは + N / clause
restrictions: Often used in rules and instructions for alternatives.
mistake: Use it for choices, not for adding two simultaneous facts.
